newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australia Cossack crude to have maintenance checks.
newsitem.headline: Australia Cossack crude to have maintenance checks.

text.p: Australia's Cossack crude field will have a maintenance shutdown for two weeks starting around 7 August, which will reduce output by half to 40,000 barrels-per-day, said an industry source.
The Cossack field is currently producing around 85,000 bpd.
The field is equally owned by Broken Hill Pty Co. Ltd, British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG(MiMi) Pty Ltd, Chevron Corp and Royal Dutch/Shell group.
The maintenance was planned, and should not disrupt term liftings, said the source.
But it will reduce the numer of available cargoes to three compared to the monthly four, added the source.
The Cossack field has had ongoing problems with its gas export system since last year.
